{{Quote|&hellip;But I have sworn to fight for the light side&hellip; even against you.|Dominus, to Zona Luka, shortly before his death|<ref name="thesithwar" />}}
'''Dominus''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was active up to and during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. A respected and venerable member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Dominus took multiple [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]], his favorite of which was the [[Vultan]] [[Zona Luka]]. However, Luka was eventually seduced to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and joined the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] under [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] in [[3996 BBY]]. Not long after, Luka, who had been ordered by Kun to [[Sith uprising|kill]] her former Master, [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|attacked]] Dominus in his [[Dominus' hut|home]]. Although Dominus was shocked at his dearest apprentice coming to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] him, he still engaged the Vultan in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Luka gained the upper hand and struck Dominus down after a brief clash, although the dying [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master gathered the strength to kill his former apprentice with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Why would anyone want to kill Master Dominus?''"<br />"''Looks like he put up a good fight.|Dace Diath and Qrrrl Toq, after discovering the scene of Dominus' death|<ref name="thesithwar" />}}
Dominus, a [[Gender/Legends|male]], was born in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. He was eventually discovered to be a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was taken by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] way. Dominus rose to the level of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], and over [[Time/Legends|time]] he became very respected. He took multiple [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]], including the [[Vultan]] [[Zona Luka]], whom he considered his dearest student. After he trained Luka to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knighthood]], Dominus retired to a small [[Dominus' hut|hut]].<ref name="thesithwar" />

[[File:ZonaVsDominus.jpg|right|thumb|308x308px|Dominus at bay.]]
In [[3996 BBY]], Luka, now under the influence of the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] released from [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Dark Holocron|holocron]], came to Dominus' home. After she revealed her loyalty to the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]], Luka challenged Dominus in battle, as Kun had ordered her and many other fallen Knights to [[Sith uprising|attack]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] their Masters. Dominus, stunned that his favorite student would attack him, drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] the Vultan. Luka gained the upper hand in their brief confrontation and was able to deal a mortal wound to Dominus. However, as the Jedi Master lay dying, he mustered the strength to kill his fallen apprentice with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The scene was later investigated by Jedi Knights [[Dace Diath]], [[Shoaneb Culu]], and [[Qrrrl Toq]], all of whom were surprised that Zona Luka would kill her former mentor and assumed she must have had potent armaments.<ref name="thesithwar" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You were my dearest student, Zona Luka&hellip;|Dominus|<ref name="thesithwar" />}}
Dominus held a certain amount of favoritism toward his former student Zona Luka, considering the Vultan to be his dearest pupil. Therefore, he was stunned when Luka, now under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], attacked him in his home. However, Dominus refused go back on his promise to defend the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]], even if it meant killing his favorite apprentice.  The Jedi who found his death site were shocked, not able to understand why anyone would want to take him out.<ref name="thesithwar" />

The Jedi Master was a grey-skinned being with black eyes and white teeth.<ref name="thesithwar" />

==Powers and abilities==
Although a respected Jedi Master, by 3996 BBY, Dominus did not possess the aptitude with a lightsaber necessary to best his former pupil Zona Luka in one-on-one combat. However, even as he lay dying, Dominus still had the ability and strength in the light side of the Force to [[Electric Judgment|kill Luka]]. After his murder, his killer was found struck dead by his lightning, atop his empty robes, [[Force ghost/Legends|his body surrendered into the Force]].<ref name="thesithwar" />

Besides his Force powers and limited saber talents, the Jedi was entrusted with [[Jedi training/Legends|teaching]] others to become Jedi.<ref name="thesithwar" />

==Equipment==
Dominus was armed with a blue-bladed lightsaber. He wore a green robe with purple trim, and a sheet of gold that rested on his back and shoulders.<ref name="thesithwar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dominus first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|fourth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]'', a story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], illustrated by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]],<ref name="thesithwar" /> and published on [[November 1]], [[1995]].<ref name="Issue4Release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54598/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_sith_war_1995_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Sith War (1995) #4}}</ref> Dominus received an entry in both the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' from [[1998]]<ref name="swe">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' released in [[2000]],<ref name="agswu">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> but in both of these reference books his name is misspelled as Dominis.
